title: Never Pour Hot Water On A Frozen Windshield
hook: Stop! Never melt ice with hot water.

script.narration: Stop! Never melt ice with hot water.
script.visual_search: pouring steaming water onto frozen car windshield

script.narration: Many drivers think boiling water clears a frozen windshield in seconds.
script.visual_search: frost and thick ice covering car windshield

script.narration: Here is the truth. Extreme temperature shock makes freezing glass expand too fast, causing instant cracks across your windshield. Instead, use your car's defroster and a plastic scraper to clear ice safely.
script.visual_search: driver scraping ice off car windshield

script.visual_search: car defroster blowing warm air windshield

description:
Trying to defrost your car in a hurry can cost you an entire windshield. Here is the real myth vs fact behind pouring hot water onto frozen auto glass, and the safer way to clear frost fast.

Save this quick tip for cold mornings and share it with new drivers who need essential winter car care and driving tips.
why_it_will_work: Seasonal myth-busting with a high-stakes repair consequence creates instant curiosity in the first two seconds and pairs well with November cold-weather driving searches.
